description: Long Island has reached a pivotal moment. We need proven leadership to take our district and our state through unprecedented challenges. Instead of politicians who focus on divisive rhetoric, we deserve a proactive public servant who is ready to represent the voices of her community. I believe in the great potential of good governance, and the importance of representatives who bring practical, local experience to the decision-making dialogues in Albany - and that's why I'm running.
